cohort: Mothers in lying-in wards of four hospitals in Ibadan, Nigeria
finding: Lower maternal education, cooking with kerosene, physical exertion at work, nulliparity, hypertension in pregnancy, prolonged rupture of membranes, breech presentation, and caesarean section were predictors of low Apgar scores at one minute, while nulliparity, male infant sex, and breech presentation were predictors at five minutes.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was a predictor of low Apgar score at one minute.
